name: Eve
source:
Eve is a young woman who was found unconscious by [url=/c82647]Yuuma[/url] outside his home on a snowy January day. After being taken in and cared for by Yuuma, Eve told him that she would now be at his service  as his maid to thank him for his kindness and to finally stop him from living a life full of loneliness and bitterness.

Eve is a very serious young woman and takes her job very much to heart by doing all the domestic chores, shopping and cooking. Having a rather maternal character, she even manages to be already on the doorstep when Yuuma comes home late at night from work to give her a warm welcome, which makes Yuuma melt with happiness.
